title: servers.member_unbanned
description: MemberUnbanned is published when a ban is revoked. It does not make the user a member again: they still need a valid invitation to rejoin.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

unbanned_by.description: Usuario con BAN_MEMBERS que revocó el ban.
